payload.core_composition_summary: Simulation uses time-event min-heap, greedy min-heap for waiting passengers, and a deque-based queue with O(1) min to enforce entry rule.
payload.rationale: Combines event-driven heap, greedy selection heap, and custom SWAG queue (deque) for efficient min tracking, illustrating multiple coordinated mechanisms.
